title: A Dynamic LLM-Powered Agent Network for Task-Oriented Agent Collaboration
authors: Zijun Liu; Yanzhe Zhang; Peng Li; Yang Liu; Diyi Yang
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent collaboration systems use a fixed number of agents and a static communication structure, which is suboptimal and costly across heterogeneous tasks and domains. DyLAN targets the question of how to automatically select an effective team of agents from a candidate pool and let them collaborate in a query-adaptive (dynamic) communication structure.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM 多 agent 協作系統採用固定數量的 agent 與靜態的通訊結構,面對異質任務與不同領域時,此設計並非最佳且成本高昂。DyLAN 針對的問題是:如何從候選 agent 池中自動挑選出有效的 agent 團隊,並使其在一個隨查詢自適應(動態)的通訊結構中協作。

key_innovation.en: A two-stage framework — Team Optimization then Task Solving — whose core mechanism is an unsupervised "Agent Importance Score" computed by backward-propagating peer LLM ratings through a Temporal Feed-Forward message-passing Network (T-FFN) to pick the best agent team offline, followed by inference-time dynamic agent activation with LLM-Ranker-based per-round team reformation (pruning weak agents mid-collaboration) and a Byzantine-consensus early-stopping rule.
key_innovation.zh: 一套兩階段框架——先進行團隊最佳化(Team Optimization),再進行任務求解(Task Solving)。其核心機制為一種無監督的「Agent Importance Score」:透過在時序前饋訊息傳遞網路(Temporal Feed-Forward message-passing Network,T-FFN)中反向傳播來自同儕 LLM 的評分,以離線方式挑選出最佳 agent 團隊;隨後於推論階段進行動態 agent 啟用,並以 LLM-Ranker 為基礎在每一輪重組團隊(於協作中途剪除表現較弱的 agent),同時搭配一條 Byzantine 共識的提早停止(early-stopping)規則。

baselines_compared: Single Execution, CoT / Complex CoT, PHP, Self-Consistency, LLM-Blender, LLM Debate, Reflexion, CodeT, LATS

key_improvements.en: HumanEval (GPT-3.5-turbo): DyLAN 82.9 Pass@1 at 16.85 API calls vs 73.2 Single Execution and 81.1 LATS (48.00 calls); with GPT-4, DyLAN 92.1 vs 88.4 Single Execution. WebShop: DyLAN 68.3 reward / 42.0% success at 24.85 calls vs 50.6 / 28.0% Direct Execution and 64.5 / 38.0% LATS (>400 calls). MMLU (1/5 subset): DyLAN 70.5% overall at 4.39 calls vs 66.4% Single Execution, 69.3% LLM-Debate (12.00 calls), 67.3% LLM-Blender.
key_improvements.zh: HumanEval(GPT-3.5-turbo):DyLAN 達 82.9 Pass@1,僅需 16.85 次 API calls,相較之下 Single Execution 為 73.2、LATS 為 81.1(48.00 次呼叫);使用 GPT-4 時,DyLAN 為 92.1,Single Execution 為 88.4。WebShop:DyLAN 達 68.3 reward / 42.0% success,需 24.85 次呼叫,相較 Direct Execution 的 50.6 / 28.0% 與 LATS 的 64.5 / 38.0%(>400 次呼叫)。MMLU(1/5 子集):DyLAN 整體達 70.5%,僅需 4.39 次呼叫,相較 Single Execution 的 66.4%、LLM-Debate 的 69.3%(12.00 次呼叫)與 LLM-Blender 的 67.3%。MATH:DyLAN 達 35.7%,需 7.15 次呼叫,相較 Single Execution 的 31.6% 與 LLM-Debate 的 32.4%。團隊最佳化使各科目 MMLU 準確率最高提升 25.0%(college mathematics 由 40.0% 提升至 65.0%)。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Temporal / cross-round edges, Termination / depth

agent_scenario.en: Multiple LLM agents sharing one backbone (all GPT-3.5-turbo or all GPT-4) but differentiated by role/persona system prompts collaborate over T rounds in a temporal feed-forward message-passing network. A candidate pool is pruned in Stage 1 to a small task-specific team (roughly 3-8 agents). During Task Solving an LLM Ranker/judge node scores peer answers each round to prune weak agents, and a >2/3 majority-agreement rule triggers early stopping. Task-specific tool use: WebShop agents act in the shopping environment ReAct-style, HumanEval agents use code-execution feedback. It is task-oriented / single-domain per run rather than a general open-ended orchestrator.
agent_scenario.zh: 多個 LLM agent 共用同一個 backbone(全為 GPT-3.5-turbo 或全為 GPT-4),但藉由角色 / persona 的 system prompt 加以區分,並在一個時序前饋訊息傳遞網路中歷經 T 輪協作。第一階段將候選池剪除為一個小型、任務專屬的團隊(約 3 至 8 個 agent)。在任務求解過程中,一個 LLM Ranker / judge 節點於每一輪對同儕答案評分以剪除較弱的 agent,並以 >2/3 多數同意規則觸發提早停止。任務專屬的工具使用:WebShop agent 以 ReAct 風格在購物環境中行動,HumanEval agent 則使用程式碼執行回饋。此系統為任務導向 / 每次執行針對單一領域,而非通用的開放式 orchestrator。
